mission.title: Our Mission
mission.description: At CodeSkillz, we believe coding education should be accessible, engaging, and effective. Our mission is to empower aspiring developers with the knowledge and skills needed to succeed in the tech industry through live, interactive instruction.

instructor.title: Meet Your Instructor
instructor.name: Farzad
instructor.bio: With years of experience in both research and teaching, I'm passionate about making complex coding concepts accessible to everyone. My background in computer science research informs my teaching approach, ensuring you learn not just how to code, but how to think like a developer.

liveClasses.description: All classes are conducted via Google Meet, allowing for real-time interaction and immediate feedback
